question: Estimate the number of WhatsApp messages sent in India during Diwali (24-hour peak).
idealClarificationQuestions: Define 'Diwali day': the actual Diwali date 24-hour window? Yes.
Include text + image + voice notes + status updates? All message types except status updates (separate).
Sent by Indian users only (not received globally)? Sent from India.
Both 1:1 and group messages counted? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: WhatsApp Indian users × peak-day multiplier × messages per user on a normal day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average messages sent per active user per day (normal): ~30-40 (text + media + voice).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average messages sent per active user per day (normal)
Diwali multiplier (greetings, festive forwards, family group floods)

calculationFlow: Average messages sent per active user per day (normal): ~30-40 (text + media + voice).
Total messages sent in 24 hours: 600M × 120 = 72 billion messages.
